definition: Layer traffic: routed D2D bytes divided by the layer-node batch, summed over channels; includes DRAM-routed traffic. Peak layer traffic: componentwise maximum across layer nodes, not simultaneous or cumulative traffic. Design bandwidth: validated effective TX/RX endpoint-minimum bandwidth, summed over channels; not an unconstrained minimum or manufactured capacity. Native mapping pool only; no distinct-pattern search was performed for these configurations.
mirror_assumption: Hypothetical full tile reflection plus rotation; channel order follows geometry, TX/RX roles preserved. Same fixed mapping, reference cycles and x8 bounds. No additional tile type or reflection cost charged.
